title: Finite supported-diagonal normalization equality
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ and the normalized Chern and diagonal data of [def-sp-tower-class-diagonal]. Use finite underlying-abelian-sheaf forgetting, exact evaluation, the root map $z\mapsto1\otimes z$ and boundary comparison of [def-sp-tower-class-finite]. The ordinary direct image along the actual diagonal is exact. Define its supported finite integer quotient by the unique residue-multiple-of-one formula on constant generators over every pulled-back chart of [def-sp-tower-class-pullback]. Evaluate the supported diagonal arrow using the exact single and shift comparisons and the normalized finite Tate-line realization. Finite diagonal normalization is the equality saying that this arrow, after forgetting scalars and precomposing with the supported integer quotient, is the evaluated signed Cartier boundary followed by the positive Kummer connecting morphism and the root map. All sources, targets, shifts and quotient maps are fixed.
